subject.title: Telegram forum: no reliable topic-name -> topic_id resolution for agent routing

question: Which Telegram agent-facing surface should own known forum topic-name to topic_id resolution for routing: a list/catalog action, a direct resolver, or context injection?
rationale: The existing cache provides observed id-to-name data, but exposing reverse routing requires maintainer intent for stale data, duplicate titles, permissions, and whether the contract belongs in message actions or session context.

options.title: Expose Observed Topic Catalog
options.body: Add a Telegram-owned list/catalog action that returns known topic ids, names, closed state, and freshness so agents can choose or ask when ambiguous.

options.title: Add Resolver-Only Helper
options.body: Add a direct name-to-id helper, accepting that duplicate or stale names must return structured ambiguity instead of silently routing.

options.title: Keep Manual IDs For Now
options.body: Leave numeric topic ids as the only supported routing contract and document the workaround until a stronger Telegram product surface is chosen.

recommendation.title: Expose Observed Topic Catalog
recommendation.body: Add a Telegram-owned list/catalog action that returns known topic ids, names, closed state, and freshness so agents can choose or ask when ambiguous.

likelyOwner.reason: They are tied to the persisted topic-name cache and review history that would likely anchor the resolver contract.
